concerns.text: T014 logic contradicts FR-004 and the Independent Test. It states: 'HALT if <100 epochs/condition... flag as underpowered if <100 epochs/condition'. This implies the pipeline continues (flags) when the threshold is not met, violating the spec's requirement that the pipeline MUST output ≥100 epochs to pass. The task must strictly halt on <100, not flag and continue.

T039 mandates removing ALL fallback logic to 'Fail Loudly' on download failure. This violates spec.md 'Edge Cases' and 'Assumptions' which explicitly require the system to 'fall back to landmark interaction timestamps' if explicit markers are absent. T039 conflates 'synthetic data generation' (forbidden) with 'event marker fallback' (required), effectively weakening the spec's recovery path.

T018 specifies computing Morlet wavelets on 'beta and low-gamma' bands. This violates FR-005 and FR-006 which strictly limit the analysis to 'alpha (8-12 Hz) and beta (13-30 Hz)'. Introducing 'low-gamma' is unauthorized scope creep that deviates from the defined research question and Constitution Principle VI.

T029 describes FWE correction but fails to explicitly constrain the input to the specific alpha/beta electrode subsets defined in FR-006 (P3/Pz/P4 alpha, F3/Fz/F4 beta). Without this explicit constraint, the task risks applying correction to the wrong feature set, violating the scope defined in FR-009 and SC-004.

Tasks T010 through T017 are all marked [P] (parallel) and assigned to the single file `code/preprocessing.py`. This violates the 'Single-File Parallelism' note within the tasks document itself and creates a semantic conflict: a sequential data pipeline (download -> filter -> ICA -> epoch) cannot be developed in parallel without a modularization strategy not present in the plan, risking merge conflicts and implementation failure.
